_notes: WoundShot harness (-woundshot, WoundShot.cs). hitsPerSide hits from each side onto the other through the real hit resolver; moves[] is the order (zone: thrust torso, heavy_overhead head, light_left/right arm, kick legs); a missing move id is skipped. contactDistM = root-to-root distance of the scripted hit (steps in by contactStepM down to contactMinM when a hit does not land, up to maxRetries). waitAfterHitSec = delay between the landed hit and the two captures. minLeftFrac/healToFrac: when the next hit could take the victim under minLeftFrac of max hp, its hp is topped up to healToFrac (never to full: a full-hp fighter loses its wounds). close* = the close camera on the wound (distance in metres at victim scale 1, fov, yaw off the attacker line, size of the render texture). maxWorkingSetGB: FAIL and abort above it; sampleEverySec: working-set log interval. decalSlack: fading decals allowed above the wounds.json maxDecals cap. fadeTol: how far below the row opacity a decal fadeFactor counts as fading. requireRealFlags: FAIL when -fast is given (the real runtime_flags.json must be used). enabled=false = the flag does nothing.
